desc: 石纹素白印张配墨松冷调棚景，十镜拆解罐装原叶绿茶的冲泡卖点结构
leaf: 罐装原叶绿茶冲泡散茶（芽叶形）
name: 石纹素白新芽青原叶绿茶款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：用米砂白平涂印张与柔散射光把罐型轮廓与体量交代干净，替掉源首屏的满版深青描金与四枚圆章角标。
把源页靠字样撑的形美主张换成可见质地：侧贴微距下叶缘与断碎率自证，等级与分档字样一律不进画面。
承接源页的原料场景屏：把描金拱框实照与红章改为方角图窗加一块空白字带，产地归属由占位符承担而不自证。
shots.textZone: 图窗下方横向字带左起一行主句，约 30pt，墨松字色

shots.intent: 一秒给出三条可选主张：把源页三枚实心图标与重复标签行改写为墨松深场上的三块方角标签板，主张全部走占位符。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行主张约 34pt，三块标签板各一行 13pt 标签，横向左对齐

shots.intent: 放大买茶最怕的断碎与尘末问题：源页只靠对照字堆叠，本镜改为一组同机位同光双联实拍，让状态自己说话。
shots.textZone: 双面板下缘各一条标签带，左一句右一句，13pt

shots.intent: 把源页两块空白对照卡与中央红色 PK 圆牌换成真正可比的一对顶视杯面，同一镜头同一光位，差异只在汤色与净度。
shots.textZone: 两面板下缘各一行 13pt 标签，中央留一枚空心方点索引

shots.intent: 复刻源页最有说服力的冲泡瞬间：叶片在热水中竖向悬浮，改直拍特写加右侧横向三行标签，替掉竖排小字列与葫芦章。
shots.textZone: 右侧竖向留白内三行横向标签，14pt，米砂白字色

shots.intent: 消解下单风险：把源页方括号里的具体只数、日期与保质期改成六行空值参数与一枚空心凭证框，字段名保留、取值一律留空。
shots.textZone: 参数区六行方括号字段名，四行取值位由标签承担，13pt 横向

shots.intent: 给选择收口：把源页三枚米白实心圆吊垂胶囊改成三只等距等光等尺的方角单元加三块空白标签板，规格字样全部走占位符。
shots.textZone: 三只单元下方各一块空白标签板，一行 13pt 短标签

shots.intent: 第二深场收口：把源页最后的促销贴片与素材站广告换成一枚空按钮位加一行主张，数值与优惠一律由后台填写。
shots.textZone: 右侧留白内一行 30pt 主张与一枚 16pt 按钮标签

style.backgroundSystem: flat matte printed colour fields only - a pale mineral-chalk sheet #EAEBE3, a stone-grey board #CFCBBE and exactly two deep-pine #1F3B37 screens; structure is carried by square-cornered hairline frames, blank rectangular label plates and one small hollow square index marker; one printed photo window onto a planted terrace is allowed once; no tile plane, no riser blocks, no shelf, no waterline reflection band, no hard-edged ink band, no gradient sweep, no arched or gold outline frame, no seal badge
style.direction: calm printed-sheet tea detail-page commerce built from flat matte colour fields, square-cornered hairline rules and blank label plates instead of ornate scenery panels
style.iconSystem: minimal single-weight line pictograms only, drawn in bud-jade #79A88F, maximum three per screen, no filled seals, no flame marks, no numbered dots, no hexagon tabs, no cloud or wave line ornaments
style.lightingSystem: one large soft diffuse key from the upper left near 6000K with a white bounce card on the shadow flank, reduced contrast, gentle falloff and a single soft contact shadow grounding every object; never a hard cast edge, never a shadowless beauty wrap, never a warm amber grade, never candlelight
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent calm printed-sheet tea detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a pale mineral-chalk field #EAEBE3, one stone-grey printed board #CFCBBE, deep-pine ink #1F3B37 used for lettering, hairline rules and exactly two dark screens, and bud-jade #79A88F as the only accent line weight; cool tone throughout; one large soft diffuse key from the upper left near 6000K with a white bounce card on the shadow flank, reduced contrast, gentle falloff and a single soft contact shadow, never a hard cast edge, never a warm amber grade; every background is a flat matte printed colour field with square-cornered hairline frames, blank rectangular label plates and one hollow square index marker, never a tile plane, never a riser block, never a waterline band, never a gradient sweep, never an arched or gold outline frame; one modern geometric sans-serif with a matching Chinese gothic, headline 28-40pt and label 10-14pt, always horizontal, never boxed, never circled, never set in a seal, no serif display, no calligraphy, no pinyin rows, no vertical caption columns; minimal single-weight line pictograms in bud-jade #79A88F, maximum three per screen; stable upright pack scale and one single main subject; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no ornamental motifs, no invented figures.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no fifth hue, no gold keylines, no metallic sheen accents, no terracotta, no violet-grey tile, no mist-blue waterline
no mixed fonts, no serif display, no brush calligraphy, no pinyin rows, no vertical caption columns
no printed seals, badges, arches, hexagon tabs, cloud line ornaments or gradient glow behind the product
no hard cast shadows and no warm amber food grade; one soft contact shadow is mandatory on every screen
no wood, bamboo, rattan, linen or rice-paper surfaces and no landscape scenery outside the single terrace window
no invented origin, mountain name, harvest window, grade, altitude, net weight, dates, storage figures, brewing temperatures or efficacy wording anywhere in frame
style.presentationRules: the pack stays whole, unclipped and at one stable upright scale on the same straight-on hero angle; brewed leaf is shown as a flat disc seen from directly above or as a suspended column seen straight-on; loose leaf is a small scatter, never a pile covering the plate labels; exactly two deep-pine screens in the whole set; the hairline rule and the blank plate are the only graphic ornament
style.surfaceSystem: matte printed boards and raw vessels only: pale mineral-chalk sheet #EAEBE3, stone-grey board #CFCBBE, deep-pine panel #1F3B37, unglazed stoneware #CFCBBE and brushed stainless steel; loose dry leaf may lie directly on the printed field; no wood grain, no bamboo slip, no rattan, no linen, no rice-paper texture, no marble, no slate, no water film
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif paired with one matching Chinese gothic, headline 28-40pt, sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, one weight per screen, always set horizontally on a blank plate or straight on the printed field; no serif display, no brush calligraphy, no pinyin letter rows, no vertical caption columns, no boxed or circled lettering
